Job Details: 
 
 
 Job Description: 
 Designs, develops, sustains, tests, validates, and debugs software to enable specific factory, wafer process, packaging features, capabilities, solutions, and/or reference platforms for Intel manufactured products.
 May work across multiple layers of the software stack spanning firmware, drivers, operating systems, database platforms, storage platforms, network/firewall, middleware, frameworks, algorithms, automated material handling systems, and/or applications for mission critical distributed enterprise systems spanning a large number of clients/servers and applications across multiple operating systems, specific technology, product/platform, or Manufacturing segment.
 Integrates, supports, and sustains Factory Automation software systems to ensure reliable and efficient manufacturing operations.
 Applies advanced troubleshooting techniques to diagnose and resolve automation system issues, minimizing system downtime and improving overall system performance.
 Drives continuous improvement initiatives to achieve automation system health goals, enhance system reliability, and support emerging manufacturing capability requirements.
 Serves as the automation subject matter expert for designated automation systems, representing system integration needs and collaborating with cross-functional and cross-site teams to drive solutions.
 Supports automation system monitoring tools, system validation, software testing, troubleshooting, and software quality control activities.
 Partners with Virtual Factory teams and relevant stakeholders to facilitate knowledge sharing, issue resolution, and continuous improvement across manufacturing sites.
 Provides 24x7 production support through a rotating day and night shift schedule, working 12-hour shifts (AA, BB, CC, DD rotation) to ensure continuous factory operations.
 
 
 Qualifications: 
 Possess a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Engineering or related fields
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 Good interpersonal and communication skills - must be able to communicate, clear message delivery in troubleshooting/swat bridge as well as written update on findings/investigation to factory users
 A good team player - support each other
 Resourceful, creative and innovative in coming out with ideas to resolve issues
 Proficient with current IT technologies
 
           
 
 
 Job Type:
Experienced Hire 
 
 Shift:
Shift 9 AA (Malaysia) 
 
 Primary Location: 
Malaysia, Kulim 
 
 Additional Locations:
 
 
 
 
 Posting Statement:
